user_prompt: Use $modal-sandbox to seed a public project into a persistent workspace and test it.

preview_commands: sandbox --workspace-volume project preview seed-git https://github.com/example/project.git --dest src
sandbox --workspace-volume project preview run "python -m pytest src"

recovery_guidance.invalid_arguments: Use a public HTTP(S) source without embedded credentials.
recovery_guidance.remote_nonzero: Report whether seeding or testing failed before changing the workflow.
recovery_guidance.timeout: Report the bounded operation that timed out.
recovery_guidance.cleanup_failure: Do not delete the persistent volume without separate user authorization.

plugin_plan.resource_boundary: Source seeding, test execution, and destructive cleanup require explicit user approval.
